Conditional extension profile. Carrier/model envelope: the declared finite coordinate state and one named compare-exchange site. Scale, resolution, admissible differences, and tolerance: metric scale is N/A; action alphabet {0,1}, exact comparator, and zero equality tolerance are supplied. Boundary role/domain/scope: N/A because no boundary is used. Orientation/coefficient system: the ordered comparator and site orientation are declared; numeric coefficients are N/A. Quantifiers: exact for one update on all pairs in the declared two-point fiber; multi-step reversal is only for a supplied finite schedule. Map/projector/fibers/reachable image: U_ij, the lifted map (U_ij,c_ij), their collision fibers, and lifted reachable image are explicit. Detector/requested answer: c_ij records which preimage branch occurred, and the requested answer is the prior coordinate pair. Reachable decoder/totalization: the left inverse is defined on the lifted reachable image; no arbitrary-log or schedule-independent totalization follows. Decoder class: exact finite set-theoretic, and executable only for the checked fixture/implementation. Separations: endpoint, path, relation, bound action receipt, work, audit, grant, resource, external-terminal result, store, and authority remain distinct. Claim labels: injectivity and one-bit local necessity are exact; reverse runs are finite fixtures; “trace” is interpretation until retained; PAL A2 placement is v2.3 synthesis. Residual/reopening: the Residual and Return-to-PAL rows control rule, site, alphabet, store, schedule, inverse, witness, and ceiling changes.
